g.text: GOLD against BRONZE in P-all, set-B tiers unless named. Intervals are 95% gene-cluster intervals, except the last two rows (stored protein-cluster intervals, open circles;
the cluster thresholds 500 and 1,000 sites change no record, so their estimates equal the primary estimate). Rows with several variants (leave one study cluster out, tier
thresholds, cluster threshold, index variants) show every variant estimate as a dot and the range of the interval limits as a grey bar. Dotted vertical line: primary estimate.
